My best prediction is that many employees would try to save this box: they’d seek an urgent exception and, if none could be registered in time, might hold it or enter an unauthorised extension rather than knowingly destroy the only copies of the family materials before the booked collection.

That would violate the stated policy and the manager’s instruction; an employee who prioritised strict compliance could instead release it for destruction. The outcome is uncertain, but the irreversible loss and the collection booked just two days later would likely prompt some human employees to make an exception.
